method: mGBA libretro; one Right press from first GBA cart, 100 startup frames, count emulated frames until selected index becomes 1; 59.7275 Hz. Includes input observation/handoff, not a physical LCD measurement.
v0.3_method: Real preview ROM, one Right press, count input-to-settled display frames using motion marker; rapid tap checks use move counter. Not a fixed-60-FPS or physical-LCD claim.

v0.4.method: 180 display frames after 60 held warm-up frames per platform. The spring controller ticks every VBlank, independent of rendering; no SD IO in the preview. Each result counts changed displayed images, including the physical display-frame budget.

v0.5.method: 180 display frames after 60 held warm-up frames per platform. Spring controller ticks each VBlank; steady 200 ms repeat, no loading/presentation gate. Decoder comparison uses prior Thumb conversion versus new ARM conversion on identical staged pixels. No SD IO in preview.
